items.summary: A Delhi High Court bench of Acting CJ Nitin Wasudeo Sambre and Justice Sanjay Sharma on Tuesday listed for Oct 16 a new PIL by Anshikha Tripathi seeking directions to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar, declare the protest right part of free speech, order an SIT probe into alleged atrocities on peaceful protesters, examine house arrests, and challenge prohibitory orders, the central-Delhi internet shutdown and metro/rail restrictions. The bench asked for a copy of the parallel SC plea to avoid contradictory orders. In court, ASG Chetan Sharma said the Supreme Court has deferred hearing on protest-related petitions till Oct 15. The HC also gave the Centre three weeks for maintainability objections in the NSUI assault-probe PIL (CCTV-preservation request, already logged).
items.title: Court calendar: Delhi HC lists fresh Jantar Mantar PIL for Oct 16; SC defers protest pleas to Oct 15
